Name: Gifts from Demetrius - Field Research Deliveries
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46483/46483-1779290708-355933619.png[/img][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=4]──────────────────────────────────── [/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=4]As your friendship with Demetrius grows, he will occasionally send carefully selected field research packages directly to your mailbox. These deliveries include minerals, mushrooms, geodes, and other natural specimens collected during his ongoing studies around Stardew Valley. [/size][/color][/center]

🇫🇷 French - 🇮🇹 Italian - 🇩🇪 German 
🇷🇺 Russian - 🇹🇷 Turkish - 🇭🇺 Hungarian
🇯🇵 Japanese - 🇨🇳 Chinese - 🇰🇷 Korean
[/center]

[center][size=4]🌍✨ [/size][size=5][b]Automatic Translation Support[/b][/size][size=4] ✨🌍[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]✔ Works seamlessly with supported languages[/center]
[center]✔ No extra setup required[/center]
[center]✔ Fully integrated with the game’s localization system[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA] 
[size=5][b]⚙️ → Installation ← ⚙️[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]1. [/b]⬇️ Download the mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] (the only place I upload—if you found it elsewhere, run 🏃). [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]2.[/b] 📦 Drop the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]3.[/b] 🧠 Extract it there like a civilized human being. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]4. [/b]🚀 Launch the game using SMAPI. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]5. [/b]🎉 Enjoy your new social life![/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=5][b]🗑️ → Uninstall ← 🗑️[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]1.[/b] 🧹 Delete the mod folder from your [i]Mods[/i] directory.[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]2.[/b] 💔 Go back to Nexus Mods and tell me why you left me (optional, but emotionally impactful). [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]3.[/b] 😢 I’ll pretend I’m fine. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]4. [/b]🌾 Go enjoy Stardew Valley without me… I guess.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=5][b]🔄 → Update ← 🔄[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]1.❗ Delete the old version (yes, really—don’t be lazy).[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA]2. 📥 Install the new version following the steps above.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]⚠️ Important:[/b]
 Do [b]NOT[/b] overwrite files. That’s how chaos begins 💀
 Delete first, then install the update like a responsible adult.[/color][/center]
